To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed a personalized recommender system that is able to mine online product reviews, fuse opinions together and provide a ranked order of similar products.
we have designed a personalized recommendation system which can fuse opinions and provide a ranked order of similar products.
we have proposed a new method to fuse opinions from multiple reviews and present a personalized recommendation system based on the fused opinions.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following questions: 1) how to extract the opinions from product reviews? 2) how to fuse the opinions together? 3) how to provide personalized recommendations? 4) how to measure the confidence of recommendation?
how to fuse product reviews and generate personalized recommendation with confidence.
a new personalized recommendation method, which is based on the opinion summary of product reviews.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the system provides a personalized recommendation with confidence.
the user is more interested in product feature A than feature B, and that the opinion on A is more consistent and has more consensus than the opinion on B.
the system can provide a personalized product recommendation based on user's preferences, product features and product reviews.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we present a novel personalized recommendation framework based on the fusion of product reviews, and the confidence factor of each product is measured by a set of quantitative attributes.
we provide a personalized recommendation system that mines the opinions from online reviews, summarizes the opinions and ranks products in a ranked order.
we provide a new way for personalized product recommendation by integrating user preference with opinion mining and confidence factor.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the confidence measurement of the recommendation is important for a recommendation system.
the confidence of the summary is a key factor in determining the quality of the summary.
we provide a framework that is flexible enough to allow for the incorporation of additional attributes and confidence measurements.
